Which statement correctly describes a change of state?
A
A gas condenses to form a liquid.
B
A liquid melts to form a solid.
C
A solid condenses to form a liquid.
D
A solid boils to form a gas.

options.label: A
options.text: A gas condenses to form a liquid.

options.label: B
options.text: A liquid melts to form a solid.

options.label: C
options.text: A solid condenses to form a liquid.

options.label: D
options.text: A solid boils to form a gas.
